$comment: Per-user rate limits (M2-10). Starter numbers, to be tuned with the client: a request over a limit gets 429 with Retry-After. humanReads and agentReads count /bars, /plan and /live connections per signed-in user or agent key (live updates on an open connection are not counted). signIn and signUp count attempts per client address; agentKeyChanges counts agent keys created or revoked per account. Windows are fixed, in seconds. The bars-per-request cap (1,000) is the History API's. Changing these needs no code change; the platform reads them at start-up.
